Population decreased in Kensington and Chelsea

The estimated population of Kensington and Chelsea in 2024 was 144,518 usual residents, a fall of 1.4% since 2023.

This meant that Kensington and Chelsea was among one of only eleven local authorities in England and Wales where the population got smaller.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Kensington and Chelsea increased by 0.2%.

Over this slightly longer period, Kensington and Chelsea was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Kensington and Chelsea

The average (median) age rose to 39.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Kensington and Chelsea has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Kensington and Chelsea is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Kensington and Chelsea's population of 144,518 usual residents was made up of:

  • 20,053 people aged 0 to 15 years, (13.9%)
  • 102,151 people aged 16 to 64 years, (70.7%)
  • 22,314 people aged 65 years and over, (15.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Kensington and Chelsea has a higher proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (70.7% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Kensington and Chelsea, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Kensington and Chelsea
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Kensington and Chelsea, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 484 people (0.3%). In total, there were 1,287 births and 803 deaths in Kensington and Chelsea.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 3,423 (-2.3%). There were 13,438 people entering the area and 16,861 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Kensington and Chelsea's population of 968 (0.7%) as a result of 6,227 people entering the area and 5,259 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Kensington and Chelsea was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Kensington and Chelsea in mid-2023 is 146,499.

Within this, international migration was revised downwards by 464 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 497 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 961 people.
